messages:
Ivy (PM): Quick thread — need a one-paragraph pilot spec for routing/isolation options to present to GTM Friday. Pick a Q3 pilot, list 3 numeric gates and rollback criteria. Keep it short.

Priya (Arch): Options: latency lanes (p99 focused, per-tenant cache), cost lanes (large batching, shared caches), residency pockets (region pin + audit). Major tradeoffs: cache scoping, cross-region state, and tenant blast radius.

Jo (Eng): Runtime notes: latency lanes -> per-tenant KV namespaces + batch_window ~ 40ms; cost lanes -> batch_window 150-200ms and permissive KV. Residency -> KMS + network path. Expect +20-40% unit cost for strict lanes.

Chen (SRE): Ops: must limit pilot blast radius to a small shard. Canary plan + automated drain required. Suggested ops gates: automated drain success >=95%, regional failover RTO <=180s.

Naomi (Sales): Pipeline: enterprise buyers ask for residency + SLAs. If we start latency-lane pilot, include a residency discovery workstream and customer checklist.

Rahul (CS): Customer ask example: fintech wants region pinning, 99.95% p99, and exportable audit events (30d). Onboarding templates speed pilots.

Ivy (PM): Ask: each owner add 1 quality gate + 1 ops gate we can use in the spec. I'll assemble.

Priya (Arch): Quality gate: per-tenant p99 <= 160ms on latency lane. Ops gate: cross-tenant tail amplification < 7% (99th percentile).

Jo (Eng): Quality gate: KV cache hit >= 55% over 24h for lane. Ops gate: median batch wait < 45ms for low-latency tenants.

Chen (SRE): Ops gate: automated drain success >=95% in canaries. Ops gate 2: regional failover RTO <=180s for critical lanes.

Naomi (Sales): GTM gate: residency discovery doc + audit export working. Sales gate: 1 paid pilot commitment or legal okay.

Rahul (CS): Customer acceptance: onboarding <= 10 business days using templates. Rollback gate: customer-facing error rate >0.5% for 1h OR two numeric gates breached for 24h.

Ivy (PM): Draft pilot checklist:
- Pilot target: 2 tenants (mid + heavy tail) on latency lane
- Duration: 6 weeks
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99, KV hit, batch window, cost/1M tokens, failover RTO, drain success rate, audit delivery latency
- Success: numeric gates met for 7 consecutive days in canary -> staged rollout
- Rollback: criteria above

Priya (Arch): Config hint for pilot (informal):
```
route_policy:
  name: latency-lane-pilot
  affinity: tenant-pin
  cache_scope: per-tenant
  batch_window_ms: 40
  fallback: cost-lane
```

Jo (Eng): Implementation: feature flag runtime toggle for batching and cache scope. Short-circuit fallback for non-critical routes.

Chen (SRE): Canary plan: shard 5 GPUs, synthetic traffic at 50% peak, automated drain dry-run, run chaos (kill a node) verify RTO.

Naomi (Sales): I'll line up two pilot customers (fintech + B2B). Need residency discovery checklist ASAP.

Ivy (PM): Consensus leaning: latency lanes pilot + parallel residency discovery. I'll publish a one-pager tomorrow and schedule kickoff. Thanks! :raised_hands:
